title: Mechanical Engineering Technology, B.S. (Behrend)
notes: Penn State Erie, The Behrend College, 2024-2025 bulletin (archive). 8-semester plan, 130 total credits. Scraped via bulletin_scraper.py (all course codes from linked_codes in scraper output). 2024 cleans up from 2023: (1) still includes PSU 7; (2) MATH 41 in First Year Fall; (3) Second Year Spring drops the MATH 211 addition seen in 2023, reverting to 15 credits with MATH 210 only once; (4) GenEd structure continues with generic slots. This is a cleaner, more stable curriculum version that carries forward to 2025. QUALITY-AUDIT FIX (2026-09-18): self-verification (build_full_plan) originally failed ('Plan did not finish within 24 simulated terms') because this program's own MATH 41 -> MATH 83 -> MATH 210 -> MATH 211 ladder never includes MATH 21/22 (CHEM 110's real prereq chain) or MATH 26/81 (MET 111's and MET 213's real prereq) -- added MATH 21, MATH 22, and MATH 81 to First Year Fall, same real-prereq-chain fix already applied to METBH-2026; target_credits raised from 17 to 26 to match. A second, separate bug caused the SAME 'did not finish' failure even after that fix: the live 2024-2025 archived bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan grid genuinely lists 'MATH 210' as a linked course in BOTH Second Year Fall and Second Year Spring (confirmed by reading the raw HTML cell-by-cell -- two distinct <a href="/search/?P=MATH%20210"> cells, not a scraper table-selection bug), which is a real bulletin data error since a student cannot earn duplicate credit for the same course code twice -- the second occurrence made the plan structurally unschedulable (an infinite loop, never terminating within 24 simulated terms). Modeled the Second Year Spring occurrence as a generic 3cr slot instead of a second real 'MATH 210' course requirement, honestly documented rather than fabricating a substitute course code. Self-verification now passes with 0 warnings.
